# Phulkan - Vulkan Bindings for PHP
## Implementation Strategy
* Implementation Traits
  * Implementation of some functionality for an object assuming a particular version/extension
* Interfaces
  * Typehinted interfaces for Vulkan objects (i.e. `VkInstance` or `VkInstance11` for Vulkan 1.1)
* Underlying Class
  * Autogenerated anonymous class at runtime per object
* Spem
  * Simple PHP Extension Maker - binds methods which contain a `#[Spem]` attribute to a C function
